column1: # The dungeon-run knobs of TortoiseBots (AiPlayerbot.DungeonRun* / AiPlayerbot.BossStand*) and what TortoiseBotsForever does with each (issue #139).
# One row per key of ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp. Columns (tab separated): key, the TB default, status, where, note.
#   read          a TBF-built source reads the config member (where = file:line, checked by forever/tools/test_run_knobs.py); "bot side only" = the run-glue half is not ported
#   ported-now    read since issue #139 (the opt-in player-led run)
#   ported-other  the behaviour is covered another way (note says how)
#   hard-coded    TBF fixes the value (where = the value, note = file:line)
#   not-read      no TBF source reads it, the config line has no effect (where = the TB reader, note = why)
# Kept in step with the source by forever/tools/test_run_knobs.py; forever/tools/gen_aiplayerbot_conf.py writes the status into aiplayerbot.conf.dist.
